facts.text: I only came to play guitar. Please, can the case stay under the table?
facts.why: No quote page was opened for this film. The plot sources have the Mariachi saying nothing like this, and the film is in Spanish with very little talk. It reads as an invented quote.
facts.fix: Use a note, not a quote: I came for work, not trouble. It's only a guitar in the case.

fix_note.text: I came for work, not trouble. It's only a guitar in the case.

facts.text: Domino's bar. The keyboard guy plays all night.
facts.why: The keyboard player belongs to the first bar, where a surly bartender hires him instead of the Mariachi. Domino's bar is where the Mariachi plays and her customers come to hear him.
facts.fix: The first bar hires a keyboard guy, not him.

facts.text: the hotel where he hides out
facts.why: He rents a cheap room at a hotel (Wikipedia calls it a motel), the hitmen attack, he kills four of them and flees. He hides upstairs at Domino's bar, not at the hotel.
facts.fix: the hotel room the hitmen storm
